scope: Newly opened LibreDWG and ACadSharp proposals on bounds, tagged dispatch, repeated counts, AcDs record framing, and annotative TEXT context.

plan_changes: Add a single scheduled source census for residual reachable unchecked count-times-width and offset-span arithmetic, using existing checked helpers.
Ensure owning repeated-DXF record tests cover late/repeated count changes and transactional no-publication where coverage is missing.
Track annotative TEXT object-context data as a distinct discovery-only route under existing context-family work; do not conflate it with ATTRIB/ATTDEF or MLEADER contexts.
Preserve the local IMAGE clipping contract absent an authoritative alternative; keep POINTCLOUD a separate unproven route.
Use peer proposals as adversarial shapes only, not support evidence, release capability, or proof of local defects.
